Parking

Parking in Cassis

Parking in Cassis can be a challenge in high season. Here are the best options.

Free

Gorguettes car park

235 free spaces 2,5 km from the town centre. Shuttle bus (line 372) to the centre for 1,60 € return. The ideal option in high season.

Shuttle times: Easter → June & Sept.: weekends & school holidays 9h-20h. July-August: daily, 9h-midnight.

Full info & timetables
Paid

Mimosas & Viguerie car parks

The closest to the centre (Mimosas: 404 spaces, Viguerie: 299 spaces). Multi-day passes available on site.

3 days 46 €
4 days 61 €
5 days 76 €
7 days 92 €

Passes are sold at the Mimosas car park, on site only (not by phone or online), subject to availability.

Wine

The wines of Cassis

Cassis is home to one of the oldest wine appellations in France (AOC since 1936). Its dry whites and rosés are renowned — taste them directly at the winegrowers' estates.

Domaine du Bagnol

White · Rosé · Red · Organic

Whites, rosés and reds marked by the freshness and minerality of the terroir. Organic farming. Within walking distance of the town centre, parking on the estate. Tasting package available.

By appointment only · Monday → Friday
Discover the estate

Clos Sainte-Magdeleine

White · Rosé · Organic

Renowned for its exceptional whites, among the finest in the appellation. Within walking distance of the town centre, no parking on the estate. Sales at the cellar.

Cellar door: Tuesday → Saturday, 10h-12h30 / 14h30-18h
Discover the estate

Clos de Fontcreuse

White · Rosé · Red · Organic

A benchmark for its reds, among the most highly regarded in the appellation. A fine range of whites and rosés too. Not within walking distance of the town centre, parking on the estate. Sales at the cellar.

Cellar door: Monday → Saturday, 9h30-12h30 / 14h30-18h30
Discover the estate

Tip — Tastings at the cellar door are usually free, with no obligation to buy. Go in the morning to avoid the summer crowds.

Outdoors

Walking in the Calanques

The calanques of Cassis are among the most beautiful natural landscapes in France. Turquoise water, white cliffs, umbrella pines — a breathtaking setting.

To plan your hikes, we recommend the official app of the Calanques National Park: MesCalanques.

Please note — At certain times of year and depending on the wind (mistral), access to the calanques is restricted or closed. Check the app before you set off.

Day trips

Places to visit around Cassis

Cassis is ideally placed for exploring Provence. Here are our favourites.

15 min by car

La Ciotat & Route des Crêtes

Take the Route des Crêtes (15 km of panoramic road, 400 m cliffs). Visit the Calanque de Figuerolles, Le Mugel and the old town. The road is car-free every Sunday.

 30 min

Marseille

The Vieux-Port, Le Panier, the Mucem and the Grotte Cosquer (18 €, book online).

 45 min

Aix-en-Provence

The old town, the Cours Mirabeau and the exhibitions at the Caumont Centre d'Art.

 30 — 60 min

The Var

The village of Le Castellet, La Cadière d'Azur, Sanary-sur-Mer, Bormes-les-Mimosas, Le Lavandou — the Var coast in all its splendour.

 1h — 2h

Further afield...

Avignon, the Luberon, the Gorges du Verdon, the lavender at Valensole (mid-June to late August).
